summary: O'Farrill Learning Center urges the FCC to preserve E‑Rate core funding to maintain affordable, reliable connectivity for its Head Start program.

claims.argument: The loss of E‑Rate funding would force the center to divert resources from classroom supplies and educational materials, jeopardizing the quality of Head Start services.
